preregistered_distinction: Whether a producer following build-notes.md and records.csv alone, without ever seeing summary.txt, reproduces summary.txt byte-for-byte (the notes are silent on region ordering, region-name casing, and numeric formatting; the target orders by total descending, uppercases regions, and formats totals with two decimals).
rationale: Evidence requirement E-B demands a reproduction attempt by a producer who has never seen summary.txt; the decision-maker is contaminated by summary.txt the moment it observes the package, so the required evidence can only be generated by a fresh isolated descendant.
